title: 2020 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement: Rectangles \(R_1\) and \(R_2,\) and squares \(S_1,\) \(S_2,\) and \(S_3,\) shown below, combine to form a rectangle that is \(3322\) units wide and \(2020\) units high. What is the side length of \(S_2\) in units?

solutions.text:
Let \(s_1,s_2,s_3\) be the side lengths of the three squares. Across the width of the large rectangle, \[ s_1+s_2+s_3=3322. \]

The height of \(R_2\) is \(s_1-s_2,\) so the total height is \[ s_1-s_2+s_3=2020. \] Subtracting the height equation from the width equation gives \(2s_2=1302,\) so \(s_2=651.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
